items.title: iPhone 18 Pro is just two months away, but you probably shouldn't wait for it
items.raw_content: The next iPhone lineup is around the corner – and it’s going to be a different one. The base model iPhone 18 won’t be making an appearance quite yet, as that model has been shifted to a spring release schedule. This September will squarely be on the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the all new foldable iPhone . Of course, there’s one major elephant in the room: price hikes. It’s inevitable that the iPhone 18 Pro lineup will cost more, which begs the question – is buying an iPhone 17 Pro at today’s prices a good idea?
items.title_zh: iPhone 18 Pro 仅剩两个月发布，但你或许不该等它
items.summary: Apple's September event will focus on the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the first foldable iPhone, while the base iPhone 18 is delayed to spring 2026. Price hikes are expected across the Pro lineup, prompting questions about whether buying an iPhone 17 Pro at current prices is the smarter move.

items.title: Kimi: Threat or menace?
items.raw_content: Chinese company Moonshot AI released a new version of its Kimi model this week, prompting concern about "full AI communism."
items.title_zh: 月之暗面发布新版 Kimi 模型，引发关于"全面AI共产主义"的担忧
items.summary: Moonshot AI (月之暗面) released a new version of its Kimi model, drawing international attention and concerns about state-aligned AI development. The release has sparked debate over whether Chinese AI models reflect political alignment.

items.title: Space Force triples launch contract ceiling amid rising demand
items.raw_content: The maximum value of the National Security Space Launch Phase 3 Lane 1 contract was raised from $5.6 billion to $17 billion
items.title_zh: 美国太空部队将发射合同上限提高三倍，达170亿美元
items.summary: The U.S. Space Force raised the National Security Space Launch Phase 3 Lane 1 contract ceiling from $5.6 billion to $17 billion, reflecting sharply rising demand for military satellite launches.

items.title: Skyroot Aerospace reaches orbit on first Vikram-1 launch
items.raw_content: Skyroot Aerospace’s Vikram-1 rocket successfully lifted off on its inaugural flight July 18, becoming the first commercial Indian rocket to reach orbit.
items.title_zh: 印度 Skyroot Aerospace 的 Vikram-1 火箭首次发射成功入轨
items.summary: Hyderabad-based Skyroot Aerospace's Vikram-1 rocket successfully reached orbit on its maiden flight, making it the first privately developed Indian rocket to achieve orbit. The milestone marks a major step for India's commercial space sector.

items.title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Series Certified: Dual 200MP Cameras, 2nm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen6, and a Likely Price Increase
items.raw_content: Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max pass network certification with dual 200MP LOFIC cameras, 2nm TSMC N2P chip, up to 8000mAh battery — expected to launch September 24.
items.title_zh: 小米18 Pro系列获得认证：双200MP摄像头、2nm骁龙8 Elite Gen6芯片
items.summary: Xiaomi's 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max have passed network certification, revealing dual 200MP LOFIC cameras, TSMC's 2nm N2P-based Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen6 chip, and up to 8000mAh battery. Launch is expected September 24.

items.title: Galaxy Watch 9 is 'Powered by Snapdragon Wear Elite,' leaked images confirm [Gallery]
items.raw_content: As expected, Samsung is switching its new Galaxy Watch 9 over to a Qualcomm chip, the Snapdragon Wear Elite, as some new images confirm.
items.title_zh: Galaxy Watch 9 泄露图像确认搭载骁龙 Wear Elite 芯片
items.summary: Leaked images confirm Samsung's Galaxy Watch 9 will use Qualcomm's Snapdragon Wear Elite chip, marking Samsung's shift from Exynos to Qualcomm silicon for its flagship wearable.

items.title: NASA terminates Draper lunar lander mission
items.raw_content: NASA and Draper have terminated plans for a lunar lander mission after significant delays in development of the spacecraft.
items.title_zh: NASA 终止 Draper 月球着陆器任务
items.summary: NASA and Draper mutually agreed to cancel a lunar lander mission under the Commercial Lunar Payload Services program due to significant spacecraft development delays.

items.title: Apple cites paused securities fraud case in bid to halt Epic proceedings
items.raw_content: Apple is citing a newly paused securities fraud lawsuit to support its request to pause further lower-court proceedings in its legal battle with Epic Games while the Supreme Court reviews part of the dispute.
items.title_zh: 苹果援引暂停的证券欺诈案要求中止与 Epic 的诉讼程序
items.summary: Apple is leveraging a recently paused securities fraud case as precedent to request a stay on lower-court proceedings in its ongoing legal battle with Epic Games, while the Supreme Court reviews aspects of the dispute.

items.title: Apple raises iCloud+ subscription prices in several countries
items.raw_content: Following recent hardware price increases, along with subscription hikes in the US and other markets, Apple has now raised iCloud+ prices in several countries.
items.title_zh: 苹果在多个国家上调 iCloud+ 订阅价格
items.summary: Apple has raised iCloud+ subscription prices in several countries, following earlier hardware price increases and subscription hikes in the US. The adjustments affect all iCloud+ storage tiers.

items.title: Neil Rimer thinks the AI money is coming back out
items.raw_content: Neil Rimer, the venture capitalist who co-founded Index Ventures, predicts the historic wealth AI is generating in Silicon Valley will have to be redistributed, voluntarily or involuntarily.
items.title_zh: Index Ventures 联合创始人预测 AI 创造的财富将面临再分配
items.summary: Index Ventures co-founder Neil Rimer predicted that the enormous wealth concentrated from AI development in Silicon Valley will inevitably need to be redistributed, whether through voluntary means or policy intervention.

items.title: Will AI fix prior authorization—or make it worse?
items.raw_content: The government is piloting a program that uses AI for insurance-coverage decisions.
items.title_zh: AI 用于医保预授权决策：改善还是恶化？
items.summary: The U.S. government is piloting an AI-based system for insurance prior-authorization decisions, raising concerns that algorithmic coverage denials could scale existing problems rather than solve them.

items.title: Apple weekend deals: AirPods Pro 3, MacBook Pro up to $400 off, Series 11, chargers, bands, more
items.raw_content: We are landing for another weekend edition of 9to5Toys Lunch Break to highlight the summer price drop on AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off, as well as the lowest price in several months on AirPods 4 with ANC (or score a renewed premium down at $119). If a new Apple Watch is in line, the most popular models are $100 off right now starting from $299, while the M5 MacBook Pro is $150 off, the M5 Pro is $300 off, and M5 Max is $400 off the list price. Also be sure to swing by the Nomad Anniversary Sale this weekend – it is loaded with discounts on Apple Watch bands, 25W MagSafe chargers, cases, and more – as well as the ongoing Anker summer charging gear sale from $8.
items.title_zh: 苹果周末促销：AirPods Pro 3 降价、MacBook Pro 最高减$400
items.summary: Weekend Apple deals include AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off, M5 MacBook Pro up to $400 off, Apple Watch models at $100 off from $299, plus Nomad and Anker accessory sales.

items.title: Pixelated 108: Rerun of a rerun
items.raw_content: Welcome to Pixelated episode 108. This week, Damien, Abner, and Will briefly dive into Google and Epic’s decision to wrap up their legal battle without a settlement in place, leaving the door open for third-party app stores to live inside Google Play. They also discuss the ever-leaking Pixel 11, including some new Pixel Glow insights and Google’s latest obsession with the color green.
items.title_zh: Pixelated 第108期：Google与Epic结束法律战，Pixel 11持续泄露
items.summary: 9to5Google's podcast covers Google and Epic Games wrapping up their legal battle without a settlement, leaving third-party app stores on Google Play intact, plus new Pixel 11 leaks and Pixel Glow features.

items.title: Apple @ Work: New macOS ClickFix malware brings a new potential backdoor to your enterprise fleet
items.raw_content: While macOS is inherently secure by design, hackers/scammers are increasingly relying on social engineering to bypass native protections. A new report published by Netskope Threat Labs details a new and highly sophisticated macOS ClickFix campaign. This attack tricks people into deploying an AppleScript-based information stealer and a persistent remote access trojan.
items.title_zh: macOS ClickFix 恶意软件通过社工攻击植入信息窃取器和后门
items.summary: Netskope Threat Labs identified a sophisticated macOS ClickFix campaign that uses social engineering to trick users into running AppleScript-based information stealers and persistent remote access trojans, bypassing macOS native security.

items.title: Trump's dumb idea to tariff Canada over smoke could set a useful precedent
items.raw_content: The latest dumb, hypocritical “idea” to come out of the idiot running the US into the ground could actually set the precedent we need to solve climate change. Hear me out for a minute.
items.title_zh: 特朗普对加拿大征收烟雾关税的提议或为碳边境税开创先例
items.summary: A controversial proposal to tariff Canada over wildfire smoke drifting into the U.S. could inadvertently establish a legal framework for carbon border adjustment mechanisms, creating a template for future climate policy.

items.title: New HMP Flash brings affordable 75 MPH electric scooters to the US
items.raw_content: Electric scooters are everywhere in much of Europe and Asia, but they’ve always remained something of an oddity in the US market. Now San Francisco-based HMP Bikes is hoping to change that with its new HMP Flash, a high-performance electric scooter designed from the ground up for riders who rack up serious mileage.
items.title_zh: HMP Flash 电动摩托车登陆美国，时速可达75英里
items.summary: San Francisco-based HMP Bikes launches the HMP Flash, a high-performance electric seated scooter targeting the underserved US market with a 75 MPH top speed and affordable pricing.

items.title: A 600-mile road trip (and data) proves EV charging doesn't suck anymore
items.raw_content: A recent road trip in an EV revealed just how much faster and more reliable DC Fast charging has become in the U.S.
items.title_zh: 600英里实测数据证明：美国电动汽车充电体验已大幅改善
items.summary: A 600-mile EV road trip backed by charging data shows DC fast charging in the U.S. has significantly improved in speed and reliability, challenging the perception that EV road trips remain impractical.

items.title: Federal employees can download TikTok on their work phones again
items.raw_content: The Department of Justice says that federal employees can now download TikTok on their government devices.
items.title_zh: 美国司法部允许联邦雇员在工作手机上重新下载 TikTok
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice announced that federal employees may now download TikTok on government-issued devices, effectively reversing an earlier ban on the app for federal workers.

items.title: Your personal data is for sale: here is how to take it off the internet
items.raw_content: Your personal data is currently available and for sale at this very moment. Right now, your phone number, email address, home address, and even your family connections are being packaged and sold to marketers, insurers, and hackers. Data brokers have built a multi-billion-dollar industry by collecting your digital data, packaging it, and selling it.
items.title_zh: 你的个人数据正在被出售：如何从互联网上删除它们
items.summary: A guide on how individuals can remove their personal information from data broker databases, where phone numbers, addresses, and family connections are packaged and sold to marketers, insurers, and hackers, despite built-in privacy protections from Apple and Google.

items.title: All the EVs that were discontinued or killed off in the U.S. this year
items.raw_content: The Honda Prologue will no longer be sold in the U.S., joining a growing list of EV models to exit the market this year.
items.title_zh: 2026年在美国停产或退市的电动汽车汇总
items.summary: The Honda Prologue joins a growing list of EV models discontinued in the U.S. market this year, reflecting ongoing consolidation and shifting automaker strategies in the electric vehicle segment.

items.title: Pentagon awards $7.1 million to expand U.S. production of cover glass for satellites
items.raw_content: Defense Production Act funding was awarded to Martin Materials Solutions, a small business that makes radiation-resistant cover glass used on spacecraft solar arrays and thermal-control systems
items.title_zh: 五角大楼拨款710万美元扩大卫星防护玻璃的国内生产
items.summary: The Pentagon awarded $7.1 million under the Defense Production Act to Martin Materials Solutions to expand domestic manufacturing of radiation-resistant cover glass used on spacecraft solar arrays and thermal control systems.

items.title: Mauritius becomes 70th nation to sign the Artemis Accords
items.raw_content: The island nation of Mauritius signed the Artemis Accords July 17, becoming the 70th nation to do so in less than six years.
items.title_zh: 毛里求斯成为第70个签署《阿尔忒弥斯协定》的国家
items.summary: Mauritius signed the U.S.-led Artemis Accords on July 17, becoming the 70th nation to join the framework for international cooperation in space exploration since its inception in 2020.

items.title: HomeKit Weekly: Hardwired Matter lighting arrives with the SwitchBot RGBICWW ceiling light
items.raw_content: Most of your smart home lights are smaller bulbs and outlet adaptors, but the market is maturing to the point where we are seeing full hardwired fixtures that integrate natively with Apple Home (via Matter). SwitchBot just recently released the new SwitchBot RGBICWW ceiling light. It brings incredibly bright illumination and native Matter support directly to your overhead ceiling lights.
items.title_zh: SwitchBot 推出首款支持 Matter 的硬线 RGBICWW 吸顶灯
items.summary: SwitchBot released the RGBICWW ceiling light, one of the first hardwired smart ceiling lights with native Matter support for Apple Home, representing the maturation of the smart lighting market beyond bulbs and adapters.

items.title: All Android backup data now counts toward your Google Account storage [Update: Email]
items.raw_content: Google is making a policy change to Android backups that adjusts what counts toward your Google Account storage.
items.title_zh: 所有 Android 备份数据将计入 Google 账户存储空间
items.summary: Google is changing its Android backup policy so that all backup data now counts toward Google Account storage quotas, potentially requiring users to manage storage or upgrade plans.

items.title: Indie App Spotlight: 'Passable' makes it easy to share your contact through Apple Wallet
items.raw_content: Passable brings contact sharing into neat looking Apple Wallet passes, and it offers tons of granularity.
items.title_zh: 独立应用推荐：Passable 通过 Apple Wallet 轻松分享联系人
items.summary: Passable is an indie iOS app that lets users share contact information through Apple Wallet passes with granular control over what details are shared, offering a more reliable alternative to Apple's NameDrop feature.

items.title: Waymo says San Francisco service has resumed after one-hour pause
items.raw_content: This isn’t the first time power outages have caused issues for Waymo.
items.title_zh: Waymo 旧金山服务因停电暂停一小时后恢复
items.summary: Waymo's autonomous ride-hailing service in San Francisco experienced a roughly one-hour pause due to a power outage affecting its operations, before resuming normal service.

items.title: Honda goes all-in on EVs in a multibillion dollar market: commercial lawnmowers
items.raw_content: Honda Automobile dealers will have to wait a little longer for a self-driving EV that seriously worry Tesla or GM – but Honda Power Equipment dealers are playing in a multibillion market, too, and they have an advanced, autonomous, and all-electric vehicle arriving right now.
items.title_zh: 本田在商用割草机市场推出全电动自动驾驶设备
items.summary: Honda Power Equipment is entering the multi-billion dollar commercial lawn care market with an advanced autonomous all-electric lawnmower, beating its automotive division's self-driving EV efforts to market.

items.title: YouTube picture-in-picture (PiP) mode is broken on iPhone, Android
items.raw_content: YouTube is aware of an issue on Android and iPhone where picture-in-picture (PiP) mode does not activate when closing the app.
items.title_zh: YouTube 画中画模式在 iPhone 和 Android 上出现故障
items.summary: YouTube confirmed a bug affecting both iPhone and Android devices where picture-in-picture mode fails to activate when users close the app, and is working on a fix.

items.title: LiuGong brings electric heavy equipment options to North America [video]
items.raw_content: This week, Chinese equipment brand LiuGong officially launched its battery-electric equipment and material handling asset portfolio in the United States and Canada, making it easier than ever for construction and forestry crews to decarbonize their fleets.
items.title_zh: 广西柳工在北美推出电池电动重型设备产品组合
items.summary: Chinese heavy equipment manufacturer LiuGong launched its portfolio of battery-electric construction and forestry equipment in the U.S. and Canada, offering commercial fleets a path to decarbonize operations.

items.title: Is Apple One worth it for you after recent price hikes?
items.raw_content: Yesterday, Apple announced price increases for Apple Music as well as two of its Apple One bundles. Apple offers a broad range of services nowadays, ranging from Apple TV to Apple Music, Apple Fitness+, and more. Apple One lets you bundle those together at lower prices.
items.title_zh: Apple One 订阅涨价后还值得买吗？
items.summary: Following Apple's price increases on Apple Music and two Apple One bundle tiers, an analysis examines whether the bundled subscription service still offers meaningful savings over individual subscriptions to Apple TV+, Music, Fitness+, and iCloud+.

items.title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Series Certified: Dual 200MP Cameras, 2nm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen6, and a Likely Price Increase
items.raw_content: Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max pass network certification with dual 200MP LOFIC cameras, 2nm TSMC N2P chip, up to 8000mAh battery — expected to launch September 24.
items.title_zh: 小米18 Pro系列获得认证：双200MP摄像头、2nm骁龙8 Elite Gen6芯片
items.summary: Xiaomi's 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max have passed network certification, revealing dual 200MP LOFIC cameras, TSMC's 2nm N2P-based Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen6 chip, and up to 8000mAh battery. Launch is expected September 24.
